summary: Run the genie-freshness commands from one script and as a sandboxed Nix check

replay.detail: Runtime claims and replay behavior are unchanged.

schema.detail: No table, schema version or claim registration changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint and admission rule versions are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Installed st and st2 binaries and release contracts are unchanged; only CI test stand-ins and a new flake check change.

downtime.detail: No daemon interruption or restart is required.

manual.detail: No operator step. The required genie-freshness check keeps its name and outcome.

recovery.detail: Reverting the change restores the inline commands; stored runtime data needs no repair.
